## 1. Set up

Load packages.

```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
```

Load data.

-   Properly format date/time data

-   Filter flow based on data quality (water level data do not have data quality stated).

    -   Data quality should be 1, 9, 10 (high quality data), 20 (fair quality) or 130 (unvalidated, but only way to get recent data)

    -   This is currently filtered for both water level and discharge, but could remove the water level line given that we are mainly interested in discharge from this dataset

```{r Data}
# Water Level Data

# Create a function for manipulating Water Level data as it comes in, including renaming the Water Level column, creating separate year/month/day/time columns and creating a date/time column in the correct format to be read as date/time

LevelDateTime <- function(dat){
  dat %>% 
  rename(Level_m = `Water Level (m AHD)`) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(substr(Date, 8,11)), 
         Month = substr(Date, 4,6),
         MonthNum = case_when(Month == "Jan" ~ 1,
                     Month == "Feb" ~ 2,
                     Month == "Mar" ~ 3,
                     Month == "Apr" ~ 4,
                     Month == "May" ~ 5,
                     Month == "Jun" ~ 6, 
                     Month == "Jul" ~ 7,
                     Month == "Aug" ~ 8,
                     Month == "Sep" ~ 9,
                     Month == "Oct" ~ 10,
                     Month == "Nov" ~ 11,
                     Month == "Dec" ~ 12),
         Day = as.numeric(substr(Date, 1,2)),
         Time = substr(Date, 13,17),
         DateTime = as.POSIXct(paste0(Day, "-", MonthNum, "-", Year, " ", Time), format = "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M")) %>% 
  subset(select = -c(Date, Site, Month, Time))
}

DunethinRock <- read_csv(here("Data/WaterLevel/DunethinRock.csv")) %>% LevelDateTime()
PicnicPoint <- read_csv(here("Data/WaterLevel/PicnicPoint.csv"))  %>% LevelDateTime()
StoneyWharf <- read_csv(here("Data/WaterLevel/StoneyWharf.csv"))  %>% LevelDateTime()
VeeRd <- read_csv(here("Data/WaterLevel/VeeRd.csv"))  %>% LevelDateTime()
SolarFarm <- read_csv(here("Data/WaterLevel/YandinaCoolumRdSolarFarm.csv")) %>% LevelDateTime()


# Flow Data
SouthMaroochyFlow <- read_csv(here("Data/Flow/141004B_South_Maroochy_River_at_Yandina.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(DateTime = as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")) %>% 
  subset(select = -c(Time)) %>% 
  subset(Level_QC %in% c(1,9,10,20,130)) %>% 
  subset(Discharge_QC %in% c(1,9,10,20,130))
NorthMaroochyFlow <- read_csv(here("Data/Flow/141009A_NorthMaroochyRiveratEumundi.csv"))  %>% 
  mutate(DateTime = as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")) %>% 
  subset(select = -c(Time)) %>% 
  subset(Level_QC %in% c(1,9,10,20,130)) %>% 
  subset(Discharge_QC %in% c(1,9,10,20,130))
```

## 2. Basic exploration

2023 January

-   plot this period to match when we're modelling for currently.

```{r Jan2023Exploration}
ggplot(DunethinRock %>% subset(DateTime >= "2023-01-01 00:00:00") %>% 
         subset(DateTime < "2023-02-02 00:00:00"), aes(DateTime, Level_m)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

ggplot(PicnicPoint %>% subset(DateTime >= "2023-01-01 00:00:00") %>% 
         subset(DateTime < "2023-02-02 00:00:00"), aes(DateTime, Level_m)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

ggplot(StoneyWharf %>% subset(DateTime >= "2023-01-01 00:00:00") %>% 
         subset(DateTime < "2023-02-02 00:00:00"), aes(DateTime, Level_m)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

ggplot(SouthMaroochyFlow %>% subset(DateTime >= "2023-01-01 00:00:00") %>% 
         subset(DateTime < "2023-02-02 00:00:00"), aes(DateTime, Discharge_cumecs)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

ggplot(NorthMaroochyFlow %>% subset(DateTime >= "2023-01-01 00:00:00") %>% 
         subset(DateTime < "2023-02-02 00:00:00"), aes(DateTime, Discharge_cumecs)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```

2024 July to 2025 July (or shorter period for one station where data were not available until November)
